text: あッ　おまえは　こないだ　トキワの　もりに　いたやつ！

structure.jp: こないだ　トキワの　もりに　いたやつ！
structure.en: the one who was in Viridian Forest the other day!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: トキワの　もりに　いたやつ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a person or thing, describes them. トキワの もりに いたやつ = 'the guy who was in Viridian Forest'.
